# Wanderlog

> > Wanderlog is a travel planning platform that helps users discover and organize the best restaurants, attractions, and experiences in destinations worldwide.

Wanderlog provides curated guides and recommendations for travelers, featuring comprehensive lists of top dining spots, activities, and local experiences. The platform helps users plan trips by highlighting the best places to visit in cities around the world.
